hadiths.text_english: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) said: 'None of you truly believes until he loves for his brother what he loves for himself.'
hadiths.text_simple: You don't have true faith until you want for others what you want for yourself.

hadiths.text_english: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) said: 'None of you truly believes until I am more beloved to him than his father, his son, and all of mankind.'
hadiths.text_simple: True faith requires loving Prophet Muhammad more than anyone else.

hadiths.text_english: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) said: 'Fear Allah wherever you are, follow a bad deed with a good deed to erase it, and treat people with good character.'
hadiths.text_simple: Fear Allah always, do good after bad to remove it, and have good manners with people.
